title: Slice fabric emitter + anomaly response playbook for per-route/model/region p95-p99
creator: Maya Rodriguez
description: Goal: Ship a lightweight emitter and dashboarding + response playbook that records rolling p95/p99 latency slices per route, per model variant, and per region; expose tokens/sec baselines and automated regression detection. This ticket implements the telemetry sidecar and dashboard templates, wires alerts into the incident runbook, and provides a short verification harness for synthetic workloads. The design emphasizes low-cardinality slice keys (route, model_family, model_variant, region, sequence_bucket) to keep cardinality bounded while preserving signal for regressions. We will also add a one-click dashboard template for Console that teams can instantiate per deployment.
acceptance_criteria: Emitter produces p95 and p99 quantile metrics at 1m and 5m rolling windows for the slice key: route|model_variant|region|seq_bucket
Dashboard template is available in Console and pre-populates with filters for route/model/region and a tokens/sec baseline panel
Regression detector can raise an alert when a slice shows a sustained p95 increase >30% vs a 7-day baseline for at least 3 minutes
Synthetic load harness reproduces three workload shapes (short-chat, long-form, embedding batch) and uploads results to the telemetry pipeline
Documentation and runbook updated with triage steps and rollback checklist
technical_notes: Emitter will sample a bounded subset of requests and aggregate histograms in-process, exporting hdrhistogram summaries to telemetry. Use existing percentiles encoder used by percentiles-mesh but restrict to 10k unique slice keys per minute.
Sequence length bucketing: [1-32,33-128,129-512,513+] to approximate KV cache effectiveness across lengths.
Tokens/sec baseline: compute exponential moving average per slice with alpha=0.2, report percent delta in dashboards.
Regression detector: lightweight service that runs sliding-window comparison; avoid full time-series anomaly detectors to keep noise low. Use configurable thresholds in console per-project.
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (canary): enable emitter on 5% of hosted traffic in us-west and europe-west for read-only routes
Phase 2: widen to 25% and enable dashboard template for internal teams; validate false positive rate against offline replay
Phase 3: 100% enablement and on-by-default dashboard for new routes; enable automatic alerting for P1 customers
Rollback: toggle emitter off in control plane; historical metrics will be retained for 30d
test_plan: Unit tests for histogram aggregation and slice key normalization
Integration test with ingest pipeline to ensure metric labels are preserved and cardinality constraints respected
Synthetic harness runs for short-chat, long-form, and embedding workloads with target tokens/sec profiles; assert p95/p99 match expected baselines within 10% on stable infra
Chaos: simulate a backend kernel slowdown and ensure detector flags regression and dashboards show attribution to model_variant and region
